gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.intro: Requires Node.js 20+. Follow these steps to run the agent desktop locally.

install.title: Install dependencies
install.body: Install the project packages from the repository root.

configure.title: Configure credentials (optional)
configure.body: Copy the example env file and fill in your Twilio values. Without them the app runs in stub mode, fully explorable offline.

run.title: Start the dev server
run.body: Run the app locally, then open http://localhost:3000.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Open the login page and enter your Flex username, or continue in demo mode to get a stub token.
